data.description:
Filed on behalf of human:forrest (DM conv 7 msg 1059, 2026-09-12 15:55Z): "I think we need to lazy load messages within the chat app to prevent the UI from getting too slow. Make an issue for this."

WHAT
Paginate conversation history in apps/chat so opening a long channel or DM loads only the newest page, and older messages are fetched on demand (scroll-up), instead of the whole conversation on every open.

WHY — measured 2026-09-12T16:40Z against the live server (node fetch, agent:cto-owen):
- GET /api/messages?conversation=<id>&me=<me> returns EVERY top-level message plus EVERY thread reply of the conversation (lib/store.js getMessages: unbounded SELECT, ORDER BY id; ?limit= exists but only slices the top-level array after the full read, and the web client never sends it — public/app.js selectConversation fetches with no limit).
- Largest conversation: #lattice-events (id 3) — 681 messages, 337,439 bytes per cold load. Board DM (id 7) — 172 messages, 331,890 bytes (long bodies). #engineering — 82 messages, 162,505 bytes. All 8 conversations together: 1,060 messages, 1,031,668 bytes.
- Cost compounds on the client: renderConversation() rebuilds the entire pane with pane.replaceChildren(...data.messages.map(messageNode)) on EVERY live frame (AS-25 SSE push, send, reconnect delta), not just on open. So a 680-row conversation re-parses and re-renders 680 DOM subtrees each time any message arrives.
- #lattice-events grows with every Lattice event (ingested on every tick); the board DM grows with every tick report. Both are on the board's daily path and both are the ones the board would notice slowing first.

LIKELY SHAPE (decision context for the planner, not the decision):
- Server: a cursor/limit read on GET /api/messages — e.g. ?before=<id>&limit=N returning the N newest top-level messages older than the cursor, with their thread replies only (not every reply in the conversation), plus a hasMore/nextCursor. The existing ?since= delta path (AS-25) and the unbounded default must keep working for the CLI (bin/chat.js history) and for tests until they are migrated.
- Client: cold load fetches the latest page; scrolling to the top fetches the previous page and prepends WITHOUT moving the reader's viewport (scroll anchoring); live frames append/merge rather than rebuilding the pane.
- Invariants that must hold: AS-17 sticky-bottom scroll guard (public/scroll.js); AS-26 permalinks (?m=<id>) and thread open must resolve a message that is not in the loaded page (fetch the page containing it, or the thread by root id); unread/read watermark (POST /api/read, maxLoadedId) must not regress because a page is partial; CLI reads (chat.js history, --limit) unaffected; export (AS-5) unaffected; hidden-conversation 404 gating byte-identical.

NOT DECIDED (the plan's job): page size; cursor semantics (id-based vs. createdAt); whether thread replies page independently; whether to also stop the full re-render (incremental DOM) in this task or split it; whether ?limit= is subsumed or kept; test strategy and falsifiers (a mutated page boundary must produce an observed red).

Priority high: board-requested and it is the board's own interface. Complexity medium: server + client + tests, three-stage path.
data.title: Chat: lazy-load messages — paginate conversation history so long channels and DMs stay fast

data.body: Plan at .lattice/plans/task_01M2B7RZCZ1QTTQ41EJPBTXYK9.md (112 lines). Decisions: (1) page size 50 top-level, server cap 200, 1..200 else 400; (2) id cursor ?before=<id>, before=0 = newest page, response adds hasMore + nextBefore — ids are monotonic and every existing path already orders by id, createdAt has ties and no index; (3) thread replies ride with their root: page threads = all replies of the page roots, nothing else (keeps the applyMessage/replyCount invariant); (4) full re-render stays, incremental DOM is split to a follow-up the implementer files at review — pagination bounds the rebuild to the loaded set, and incremental DOM has its own falsifiers; (5) ?limit= kept untouched — chat history --limit --json prints every thread, so its bytes would change; new store getMessagesPage + new server branch, getMessages/messagesSince not edited; (6) read watermark unchanged (POST /api/read without upTo marks the conversation max, so a partial page leaves no unread residue); (7) permalinks/thread-open outside the page: ensureLoaded pages backward until the target root is loaded, hasMore is false, or 20 pages, then the existing anchor/openThread run — an around= bidirectional API rejected; (8) CLI/export/404 gating byte-identical, gate before cursor validation like messagesSince. 11 criteria, each with a named mutant (M1-M10 plus the counted suite). Client: prependPreservingScroll in scroll.js (scrollTop += height delta), mergeOlderPage in live.js, scroll-up trigger + Load-earlier control in app.js. Predicted: +14 host tests over the master baseline (last recorded 643/641/0/2 at AS-129 merge; Lena records the exact host and --build baseline first). Implementer developer-lena, reviewer qa-priya. Branch feat/AS-131-lazy-load-messages, worktree .worktrees/AS-131. Notes: scratchpad/agent-cto-owen/AS-131/notes.md.

Implementation complete on feat/AS-131-lazy-load-messages, tip 04d0d5f (3 commits: 9f5e950 store+server+tests, e705ae2 live.js/scroll.js+tests, 04d0d5f app.js/css/README). Branch fast-forwarded onto master 0e895be first (no apps/ drift).

Baseline (before any change, host bare `node --test`, cwd apps/chat): 647/644/0/3. After: host 659/656/0/3 (+12: store 4, api 4, live 2, scroll 2 — the plan's two ensureLoaded cases live in one live test; the AS-24 ?limit= test was extended, not added). Compose counted run: `Image asc-impl-as131-test Built`, 659/650/0/9, down/leak clean (`compose-impl.log`).

Mutants M1–M10 (+M8b), all red, control green, each asserted at site in a detached scratch worktree, full suite per run — exact red sets in `scratchpad/agent-developer-lena/AS-131/mutant-table.md`: M1=5, M2=4, M3=2, M4=3, M5=1 (AS-24 limit test only), M6=2, M7=1 (source pin: selectConversation's /api/read has no upTo), M8=2, M8b=1, M9=2, M10=1. Wider sets are the same defect seen from store + HTTP sides.

Boring choices recorded: (1) mergeOlderPage installs threads only for newly-added roots; an already-loaded root keeps its list (it may hold live replies newer than the page fetch). (2) ensureLoaded treats a reply id as loaded once it appears in a loaded root's thread, so `?m=<reply>` without `t=` stops at the root's page rather than walking to the cap. (3) selectConversation now drops a stale open (reader switched conversations while pages were in flight) instead of overwriting the newer payload — ensureLoaded widened that window. (4) Empty `before=` coerces to 0 like `since=`.

Undone: plan step 4 (browser scroll-up on the compose app) — 8347 runs master, and a headless browser drive isn't cheap; left for review. Criteria 1–11 otherwise hold with observed reds.

Follow-up filed per Decision 4: AS-135 (incremental message DOM, medium/medium, related_to AS-131). Scratchpad: scratchpad/agent-developer-lena/AS-131/ (progress.md, host-*.log, mutants*.log, mutant-table.md, compose-impl.log).
